content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The Improved Homeland Defense Interceptors program (budget code 0604874C) is run by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and funds the development, integration, and testing of a Next Generation Interceptor — an all-up-round (AUR) missile consisting of an integrated boost vehicle and multiple kill vehicle payload designed to survive both natural and hostile environments while countering the assigned threat.","citation":{"fact_id":"79a41626f4e3618b"}},{"text":"The interceptor is intended to give U.S. Northern Command (USNORTHCOM) a solution that is lethal across the specified threat space, upgradeable to address future threats, and fully integrated into the existing Ground-Based Midcourse Defense (GMD) Weapon System.","citation":{"fact_id":"41e9d21fa87ab437"}},{"text":"The MDA issued a Request for Proposal in fiscal year 2020 and competitively awarded two best-value contracts on March 24, 2021, for the Next Generation Interceptor acquisition.","citation":{"fact_id":"986d58dd318f7a6e"}},{"text":"The agency maintained competition through Preliminary Design Reviews and Knowledge Point 1 in fiscal year 2024, then selected a single prime contractor for continued development through Critical Design Review, qualification, integration with the GMD Weapon System, ground/cyber and flight testing, and AUR production.","citation":{"fact_id":"f02cf530cae9c9a9"}},{"text":"The program has two projects: Next Generation Interceptor Development (project MD80) and Program Wide Support (project MD40), which covers non-headquarters management costs allocated across MDA activities on a pro-rata basis.","citation":{"fact_id":"d12a89e3e5a7d959"}},{"text":"Program Wide Support funds MDA-wide functions such as government civilians and contract support, physical and technical security, facility leases and maintenance, and oversight of the broader Missile Defense System.","citation":{"fact_id":"9620456c2302dada"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"This is a large, high-priority research line: fiscal year 2024 actual spending reached about $2.07 billion (in USD thousands, $2,073,886).","citation":{"fact_id":"6005a42abd97e7fc"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2025, Congress enacted about $1.67 billion ($1,670,256 thousand).","citation":{"fact_id":"8e36920c49ebd4be"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total request is about $1.64 billion ($1,637,414 thousand), made up of a $1,582,414 thousand discretionary request plus a $55,000 thousand reconciliation request.","citation":{"fact_id":"468e3560081d4a92"}},{"text":"That fiscal year 2026 total represents a decrease of about $32.8 million ($32,842 thousand), or roughly 2 percent, from the fiscal year 2025 level.","citation":{"fact_id":"44230f06083e8719"}},{"text":"The program is tied to national defense policy: a Presidential Executive Order dated January 27, 2025, established a goal of protecting U.S. citizens and critical infrastructure and securing second-strike capability against missile attack from any adversary, and this budget submission reflects changes to meet that mission.","citation":{"fact_id":"79a41626f4e3618b"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The Missile Defense Agency (MDA) is the organization responsible for the program.","citation":{"fact_id":"6005a42abd97e7fc"}},{"text":"Lobbying filings from Lockheed Martin Corporation referenced defense and appropriations legislation and matched the term \"Homeland,\" including a 2024 filing on the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024.","citation":{"fact_id":"023bc6383852614c"}},{"text":"Lockheed Martin also reported lobbying in 2025 on continuing appropriations legislation matching the term \"Homeland.\"","citation":{"fact_id":"0376018b1776fe86"}},{"text":"Filings from The Boeing Company referenced monitoring congressional developments on Defense, Foreign Policy, Space Exploration and Homeland Security in 2024.","citation":{"fact_id":"091ddf10089af190"}},{"text":"Boeing Company filings in 2025 and 2026 referenced Department of Homeland Security appropriations legislation such as H.R.4213.","citation":{"fact_id":"01bfec7dbc6c2604"}},{"text":"General Dynamics Corp filings referenced Fiscal Year 2024 Defense Appropriations and Homeland Security issues in 2024.","citation":{"fact_id":"0a02c9a05511f8d9"}},{"text":"General Dynamics filings in 2025 and 2026 referenced later Defense and Homeland Security appropriations, including Fiscal Year 2026 and Fiscal Year 2027 measures.","citation":{"fact_id":"00f0e530ed89366d"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
